quest.title: Toward Red-Hot Adventure!
quest.description: You meet Katheryne once again in Natlan...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild, and to Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Please wait a moment. Once you've registered, you'll be able to accept commissions here.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Natlan is a land full of challenge and opportunity, filled with powerful foes and unexplored ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Be bold and confident, and you'll be able to seize these opportunities and accomplish great things.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque, Adventurer! Forge onward, to reach the stars and conquer the abyss!
